tweets.text:
AI has a weird problem right now.

Money is abundant. Compute isn’t.

You can raise capital quickly, but GPUs, power, cooling and infrastructure are much harder to scale.

That’s why @b3labs caught my attention.

$B3 is roughly a ~$27M token behind an ecosystem building real NVIDIA GPU machines used by researchers at universities including Stanford and NYU.

B3IQ lets users own the hardware, use it when needed, and make unused capacity available through Earn Mode.

Small cap. Real hardware. Real demand. One I’m watching.

tweets.text:
This week's Trump-Xi meeting is the biggest macro event to watch for.

One of the key topics is expected to be China’s purchases of Iranian oil, at a time when Hormuz is still mostly closed.

If the US convinces China to buy less oil from Iran, it would put more pressure on Iran to negotiate, which could result in Hormuz reopening.

Hormuz reopening means oil prices will drop, inflation will cool down, and Fed rate hike odds will go down.

And if the opposite of that happens, markets could see a selloff.
